privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This website uses cookies only to the extent necessary for its proper operation.
privacy.section1_text: We use only session cookies that are necessary for the login system to function. We do not use analytical, advertising, or tracking cookies.
privacy.section2_text: During registration we collect: username, email address, and an encrypted password. Data is stored on the server and is not shared with third parties.
privacy.section3_text: Data processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest of the data controller).
privacy.section4_text: You have the right to access your data, rectify it, erase it, or restrict its processing. To exercise these rights, please contact the data controller.
